text: Three mouse genetic models were reported. mGluR6 knockout mice, exploiting the receptor's retinal ON bipolar cell-restricted expression, lost ON light responses while OFF responses were unchanged; retinal organization and optic fiber projections remained normal, and mutants retained visual behavior in shuttle box avoidance, showing mGluR6 is essential for synaptic transmission to ON bipolar cells and that the OFF pathway carries important visual information. A conditional p75(NTR) allele (p75(NTR-FX)) flanking exons 4–6, encoding transmembrane and cytoplasmic domains with loxP sites, was validated by neural crest-specific p75(NTR)/Wnt1-Cre and conventional null mutants; both showed abnormal hind limb reflexes and peripheral neuropathy. Nrg1/ErbB4 signalling cell-autonomously controls cortical GABA interneuron connectivity development, contradicting the prevailing excitatory-synapse view.
